questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Badgers or Dolphins?
Who has achieved the fifty and 5 wickets in a match double more times, Johmari Logtenberg or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Johmari Logtenberg: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Runs' in the 09/10 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Trisha Chetty holds it, with a total of 437.

questions.question: How many catches separate the all-time #1 (Nondumiso Shangase) and #2 (Tatum le Roux) fielders (T20)?
questions.explanation: Nondumiso Shangase: 29 — Tatum le Roux: 23 — a gap of 6.

questions.question: At which ground did Robyn Appels record their career-best bowling figures (6-41, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Newlands Stadium, against Dragons on 2022/02/26.

questions.question: "Lions" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: Both Central Gauteng and Gauteng were folded into the Lions.
